{"question": "Combien de chefs de département ont plus de 56 ans ?", "schema": "CREATE TABLE "department" (
"Department_ID" int,
"Name" text,
"Creation" text,
"Ranking" int,
"Budget_in_Billions" real,
"Num_Employees" real,

);

CREATE TABLE "head" (
"head_ID" int,
"name" text,
"born_state" text,
"age" real,
PRIMARY KEY ("head_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "management" (
"department_ID" int,
"head_ID" int,
"temporary_acting" text,

FOREIGN KEY ("Department_ID") REFERENCES `department`("Department_ID"),
FOREIGN KEY ("head_ID") REFERENCES `head`("head_ID")
);"}
